limitations: This matrix links missing external artifacts to failed/deferred acceptance metrics; it does not supply external data.
Production credit can only change after all artifacts pass the strict drop gate, controlled copy is applied, campaigns are rebuilt, and the final verifier passes.

operator_execution_order.purpose: Populate the real-CAD, SBEPV5, and fire-calibration drop folders without touching controlled evidence.
Validate file presence, schemas, columns, counts, and domain-specific identifiers.
Regenerate controlled-copy source/target mapping from validated drop evidence.
Inspect target conflicts and copy readiness without writing evidence files.
Copy only after every external artifact gate is PASS and the operator explicitly confirms.
Rebuild all dependent evidence, run the verifier, and update the production-readiness ledger.
